comment: Epic Fights (src/epic.py): the story's great battles. hero: the player's character (form: the Super Saiyan level it starts at), allies: who fights with it; waves: the enemies, one wave after the other (up to 4 at once), their leader first; boss_form: the level the leader starts at. Online, the host plays the hero's side and the other player the leader's side (with the rest of the first wave). music: a soundtrack of Sounds/ (without extension). quest: what it takes besides beating everyone (src/epic.py Quest): survive (seconds), protect (allies who must not fall), finisher (the technique the boss must be beaten with). face: who the versus card and the list show against the heroes (else the first wave's leader). In an Epic Fight the allies and enemies keep their forms (no power-up, fusion or absorption).

fights.title: The Legendary Super Saiyan
fights.subtitle: Goku vs Frieza
intro: You monkeys never learn. I will destroy you and this planet!
You've hurt too many people, Frieza. I won't forgive you!

fights.title: Cooler's Revenge
fights.subtitle: Goku vs Cooler
intro: My little brother was a disgrace. Watch the true power of our family.
Then I'll beat you the same way I beat him!

fights.title: The Last Hope
fights.subtitle: Future Gohan and Teen Trunks vs Androids 17 and 18
intro: Two little heroes again? This won't take long.
Trunks, they're too strong. Hold them off with me, just one minute!
Right, Gohan! I won't let them win!

fights.title: A Future Without Hope
fights.subtitle: Future Trunks vs Androids 17 and 18
intro: Another one who wants to play? Fine, it's been boring lately.
This time I'll end your reign of terror!

fights.title: Super Android 13!
fights.subtitle: Goku, Vegeta and Trunks vs Androids 19, 20 and 13
intro: Dr. Gero's last creation will finish what I started.
Everybody, together! We can't let them win!

fights.title: Seven Little Monsters
fights.subtitle: Goku, Vegeta, Trunks and the Z Fighters vs the seven Cell Juniors
fights.music: legacy-of-goku-II/The Legacy Of Goku 2 OST - The Imperfect Cell
intro: Hee hee! Papa said we can play with you! All seven of us!
Everybody, one each! Don't let them get past you!

fights.title: The Cell Games
fights.subtitle: Teen Gohan vs Perfect Cell
intro: So this is the power you were hiding. Show me everything!
I'm going to make you suffer, Cell.

fights.title: New Hope
fights.subtitle: Trunks vs Imperfect Cell
intro: Your energy smells delicious. I'll absorb you, then the androids!
Not while I'm here. You won't reach them, Cell!

fights.title: Broly: Second Coming
fights.subtitle: Gohan, Goten and Trunks vs Broly
intro: Goten, Trunks, stay together! We'll beat him as a team!

fights.title: Gotenks, the Kid Hero
fights.subtitle: Gotenks vs Super Buu
intro: I'm bored. Entertain me, or I'll eat you.
The Grim Reaper of Justice has arrived! Super Ghost Kamikaze Attack!

fights.title: The Ultimate Warrior
fights.subtitle: Ultimate Gohan vs Super Buu (Gotenks)
intro: I absorbed Gotenks. Now I'm even stronger!
That won't be enough. Your time is up, Buu.

fights.title: Vegito Is Born
fights.subtitle: Vegito vs Super Buu (Gohan)
intro: With Gohan inside me, nobody can stop me.
I'm not Goku, I'm not Vegeta. I'm the one who's going to beat you.

fights.title: The Final Battle
fights.subtitle: Goku SSJ3 vs Kid Buu
intro: Kakarot, I'll hold him off. Gather everyone's energy!
Everyone, lend me your energy! Spirit Bomb!

fights.title: Black's Rosé
fights.subtitle: Future Trunks, Vegeta and Vegito Blue vs Goku Black
intro: Mortals are a mistake. Behold the beauty of Super Saiyan Rosé.
Then you're about to meet Super Saiyan Blue.
You took everything from my world. I'll never forgive you!
